en: Black‑and‑white vertical postcard-style photograph showing a steep stone stairway with metal railings climbing along a stone wall. A few women in long skirts and blouses are descending the steps, suggesting an early 20th‑century scene. At the top left rises a large church tower with a distinctive onion-shaped dome and lantern, typical of Central or Eastern European Baroque architecture. Trees and vegetation line the right side; older masonry buildings sit above the wall on the left. The bottom edge of the print shows damage and torn paper, but no visible caption or border text.
